paths.name: Path of Havoc
paths.description: A mastery path focused on damage from afar

ability.name: Fiery Winds
ability.description: Flickering Red Fire and Surging Violet Fire will hit one additional enemy up to 15 feet away from the target.

ability.name: Perils of The Warp
ability.description: You open a rift dealing 365 Elemental damage and weakening the fabric of reality surrounding your target, disarming them for 4 seconds.

ability.name: Changer's Blessing
ability.description: Surging Violet Fire will now heal you for 50% of damage dealt.

ability.name: Bolt of Change
ability.description: An undefendable bolt of far traveling force that inflicts 883 Elemental damage.

ability.name: Chaos Unleashed
ability.description: Increases the critical hit rate of all Path of Havoc spells by 15%.

ability.name: Indigo Fire of Change
ability.description: A horrible torrent of energy that deals 536 Elemental damage every 2 seconds for 6 seconds. Victims killed while bathed in this flame will return 120 Action Points over 6 seconds to you.

ability.name: Soul Leak
ability.description: Deals 2394 damage over 10 seconds and removes 50 Action Points every 2 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Flickering Red Fire
coreAbilities.description: Summons a chaotic bundle of red flame that flies toward your opponent to inflict 436 Elemental damage.

coreAbilities.name: Daemonic Fire
coreAbilities.description: Your Pink Horror flings daemonic fire at its target, burning them for 291 Elemental damage and reducing their Elemental Resistance by 360 for the next 20 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Baleful Transmogrification
coreAbilities.description: Bends and twists your target from within to deal 1155 Elemental damage over 15 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Surging Violet Fire
coreAbilities.description: Tendrils of writhing violet flame coil around your target, burning them for 328 Elemental damage.

coreAbilities.name: Daemonic Consumption
coreAbilities.description: Your Pink Horror forces daemonic power into its target, lowering the target's chance to critically hit by 5% and dealing 276 Elemental damage over 10 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Withered Soul
coreAbilities.description: Your malice is forced directly into your target's soul, inflicting 1730 Elemental damage over 20 seconds while reducing their Disrupt chance by 5%.

coreAbilities.name: Mutating Blue Fire
coreAbilities.description: A column of blue flame washes over your target, dealing 718 Elemental damage and then dealing an additional 576 Elemental damage over 9 seconds.

paths.name: Path of Changing
paths.description: A mastery path focused on faster casting shorter range damage

ability.name: Endless Pandemonium
ability.description: Pandemonium will now reapply its damage effect 50% of the time after it ends or is removed.

ability.name: Seed of Chaos
ability.description: Grows a seed inside your target dealing 605 Spirit damage over 15 seconds. After this time expires or the target is killed, the seed will explode using the victims life force to deal 265 Spirit damage to all targets within 20 feet.

ability.name: Daemonic Reach
ability.description: Increases the ranges of all Path of Changing abilities by 25%.

ability.name: Tzeentch's Firestorm
ability.description: Summons a great column of wind and flame that deals 365 Spirit damage every 2 seconds to all targets within 20 feet of the area for 6 seconds, and snares them by 20%. If there are multiple Tzeentch's Firestorms targeting the same area, only the highest level one will deal damage.

ability.name: Wild Changing
ability.description: Increases critical chance for all Path Of Changing spells by 15%

ability.name: Dissolving Mist
ability.description:
Summons a cloud of caustic mist that deals 112 Spirit damage every 2 seconds to targets within 20 feet of the summoning point. After 10 seconds  the cloud doubles in strength, dealing 212 Spirit damage and 10 seconds later will double in strength again, dealing 312 Spirit damage.
 If there are multiple Dissolving Mist in the same area only the highest level mist will deal damage.

ability.name: Daemonic Scream
ability.description: Deals 2400 damage to all targets in a line in front of you up to 65 feet away.

coreAbilities.name: Rend Winds
coreAbilities.description: Tears at your foe with fierce winds, hitting them three times for a total of 121 Spirit damage. This ability will continue to build up even if you move.

coreAbilities.name: Glean Magic
coreAbilities.description: You strip away the Spiritual protections of everyone 20 feet from your target, reducing their Spirit resistance by 240 and dealing 560 Spirit damage over 20 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Flame of Tzeentch
coreAbilities.description: Your Flamer focuses two gouts of flame on its target, dealing 117 Spirit damage every 1 seconds for 2 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Flames of Change
coreAbilities.description: Your Flamer hurls a gout of daemonic fire that will strike its target and those 20 feet around them, dealing 296 Spirit damage over 6 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Surge of Insanity
coreAbilities.description: A surge of chaotic bliss overcomes your target, dealing 403 Spirit damage.  The victim and any other enemies within 20 feet of them are also interruped, cancelling any abilities that they are building up. This ability will continue to build up even if you move.

coreAbilities.name: Pandemonium
coreAbilities.description: Chaotic swirls of power inflict 1055 Spirit damage over 15 seconds to your target and those within 20 feet of them. This ability will continue to build up even if you move.

coreAbilities.name: Warping Blast
coreAbilities.description: Energy spirals towards your foe, dealing 403 Spirit damage and knocking them back a short distance. Monsters will be knocked down. This ability will continue to build up even if you move.

paths.name: Path of Daemonology
paths.description: A mastery path focused on daemons and close combat

ability.name: Lasting Chaos
ability.description: When you summon a Daemon, it will restore 20 Action Points to everyone within 25 feet every 2 seconds.

ability.name: Agonizing Torrent
ability.description: Your disk emanates an aura of pain that inflicts 270 Spirit damage every 3 seconds for 9 seconds.

ability.name: Daemonic Contract
ability.description:
Your damage is increased by 15% when under 45 feet away from your target.
Does not affect damage procs.

ability.name: Aegis of Orange Fire
ability.description: You summon and absorb orange flames to increase your Wounds by 250, increasing your total life for 20 seconds. During this time, any enemies striking you has a 25% chance to receive 348 Elemental damage from your flames.

ability.name: Daemonic Pact
ability.description: Forms a pact with newly summoned daemons that increases both you and your daemon's Toughness by 160 while it remains in this realm.

ability.name: Chaotic Rift
ability.description: A rift in the warp is opened briefly, pulling up to six enemy players within 65 feet of the vortex towards its center and then snaring everyone within 25 feet a second later by 30% for 5 seconds. Monsters will be knocked down by the initial pull.

ability.name: Firewyrm of Tzeentch
ability.description: Summons a mighty Firewyrm that will rampage around attacking your enemies for 16 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Infernal Blast
coreAbilities.description: A daemonic wave that warps the air in front of you dealing 812 Elemental damage over 9 seconds to all targets 40 feet in front of you.

coreAbilities.name: Daemonic Lash
coreAbilities.description: An ethereal tentacle swipes all enemies 40 feet in front of you for 278 Spirit damage.

coreAbilities.name: Warping Energy
coreAbilities.description: Your Blue Horror spews out a cone of daemonic energy that inflicts 214 Spirit damage to targets up to 40 feet in front of Horror.

coreAbilities.name: Coruscating Energy
coreAbilities.description: Your Blue Horror releases a field of energy dealing 141 Elemental damage every second to all targets within 25 feet for 3 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Daemonic Infestation
coreAbilities.description: You call forth a small daemon which will persist in an area for 1 minute. The daemon will explode when an enemy gets too close, dealing 343 damage to all enemies within 30 feet and staggering them for 3 seconds, preventing all actions until they take damage.

coreAbilities.name: Daemonic Resistance
coreAbilities.description: You surround a single group member with daemonic resistance, increasing their Resistances by 360 for 60 minutes.

coreAbilities.name: Warpfire
coreAbilities.description: You channel warping flame through your disk, dealing 217 Elemental damage to all targets within 25 feet of you every second for 3 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Enhance War Engine
coreAbilities.note: Not usable on Siege Rams or Oil
coreAbilities.description: Siege Targetted buff. Increases damage done by that siege engine by 2% for 10 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Hex War Engine
coreAbilities.note: Not usable on Siege Rams or Oil
coreAbilities.description: Siege Targetted debuff. Increases the cooldown times of that siege engine by 50% for 10 seconds

coreAbilities.name: Abate War Engine
coreAbilities.note: Not usable on Siege Rams or Oil
coreAbilities.description: Siege Targetted debuff. Decreases damage done by that siege engine to 98% for 10 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Flee
coreAbilities.description: You run away from the battle in a mad panic, increasing your run speed by 30% for 10 seconds.  You immediately lose all of your action points, any career mechanic points, and your Morale will begin to drop, and you will not begin to regain action points until 10 seconds have passed.

coreAbilities.name: Daemonic Maw
coreAbilities.description: Deals 328 Spirit damage and reduces movement speed by 40% for 10 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Summon Pink Horror
coreAbilities.description: Summons a daemonic minion who specializes in long range Elemental based attacks. This minion is confined to its summoning circle and cannot move. The daemonic minion gains 100% of your Intelligence from item bonuses and 50% of your Wounds from item bonuses. While you are within 30 feet of the minion you will be steadily empowered by its unholy energy, increasing your damage by 4% every 2 seconds to a maximum of 20%.

coreAbilities.name: Resummon
coreAbilities.description: You shift your active summoning circle to your current location, bringing your minion with it.

coreAbilities.name: Summon Blue Horror
coreAbilities.description: Summons a daemonic minion who specializes in short range Spiritual and Elemental area of effect attacks. This minion is confined to its summoning circle and cannot move. The daemonic minion gains 50% of your Intelligence from item bonuses and 100% of your Wounds from item bonuses. While you are within 30 feet of the minion you will be steadily empowered by its unholy energy, increasing your damage by 4% every 2 seconds to a maximum of 20%.

coreAbilities.name: Horrifying Visions
coreAbilities.description: Horrifying images distract your opponent, causing them to deal only 50% damage against you for 15 seconds.  You will also deal 50% damage to them until the effect is broken. You will stop attacking when you use this ability, and the effect will fade if you attack someone that you have detaunted.

coreAbilities.name: Summon Flamer
coreAbilities.description: Summons a daemonic minion who specializes in powerful moderate range Spiritual attacks. This minion is confined to its summoning circle and cannot move. The daemonic minion gains 75% of your Intelligence from item bonuses and 75% of your Wounds from item bonuses. While you are within 30 feet of the minion you will be steadily empowered by its unholy energy, increasing your damage by 4% every 2 seconds to a maximum of 20%.

coreAbilities.name: Mage Bolt
coreAbilities.description: A focused blast that deals 600 damage and knocks the targeted player away. Monsters will be knocked down.

coreAbilities.name: Warped Flesh
coreAbilities.description:
Any time you are attacked, there is a 25% chance that you will absorb up to 375 damage.
This effect will not trigger more than once every 3 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Tzeentch's Grasp
coreAbilities.description: A summoning wave passes over enemies within 25 feet of you, calling forth horrific tentacles to bind their movement for 5 seconds. There is a 50% chance of the root breaking with every hit.

coreAbilities.name: Daemonic Armor
coreAbilities.description: You surround group members within 100 ft with daemonic protection, increasing their Armor by 396 for 60 minutes, while increasing your Armor by 792 for 60 minutes.

coreAbilities.name: Siphon Power
coreAbilities.description: You drain power from your target, stealing up to 200 action points from your target and giving them to you. Your target's Intelligence will also be reduced by 150 for 30 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Devour Energy
coreAbilities.description: Whenever one of your spells hits an enemy, you have a 25% chance to regain 30 Action Points. This effect cannot occur more than once every 2 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Infernal Flesh
coreAbilities.description: Daemons will be summoned with 160 more Wounds.

coreAbilities.name: Endless Knowledge
coreAbilities.description: Increases your Intelligence by 160.

coreAbilities.name: Misdirection
coreAbilities.description: You gain a strong counter aura for the next 10 seconds that will reduce half of any incoming Magic damage and redirect half of any direct damage back to the caster.

coreAbilities.name: Tzeentch's Warding
coreAbilities.description: Increases your Elemental resistance by 252.

coreAbilities.name: Focused Mind
coreAbilities.description: For the next 10 seconds, you will remove and ignore any rooting, snaring, disarming, silencing or disabling effects. Your cast times are reduced by 50%, and you cannot be set back.

coreAbilities.name: Unearthly Shriek
coreAbilities.description:
Pink Horrors, Blue Horrors and Flamers of Tzeentch now have a 15% chance to taunt their targets with every attack. This enrages the target, interrupting any building actions and forces monsters to target your pet for 5 seconds. Taunted targets receive  20% more damage from your daemon. If your daemon is struck 3 times by their taunted target, taunt will be broken.
Does not affect damage procs.

coreAbilities.name: Shocking Jolt
coreAbilities.description: You remove stagger effects from an ally and five other allies within 25 feet.

coreAbilities.name: Backlash
coreAbilities.description: Any time you are attacked, there is a 25% chance that you will lash out for 370 Elemental damage over 5 seconds to anyone who hits you.

coreAbilities.name: Scintillating Energy
coreAbilities.description: Deals 1200 damage to your target and staggers them for 9 seconds, preventing all actions until they take damage.

coreAbilities.name: Instability
coreAbilities.description: You force so much power into your daemon that it explodes from within, dealing 370 Spirit damage to all targets within 25 feet, knocking them down for 3 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Sleight of Hand
coreAbilities.description: Enemy monsters will hate you 50% less than normal.

coreAbilities.name: Flame's Kiss
coreAbilities.description: Rend Winds and Flickering Red Fire are now virtually undefendable.

coreAbilities.name: Grasping Darkness
coreAbilities.description: Deals 798 damage over 6 seconds and Snares by 60% for 6 seconds

coreAbilities.name: Close Quarters
coreAbilities.description: Your cast times are reduced to 50% when you are within 20 feet of your target.

coreAbilities.name: Chaotic Attunement
coreAbilities.description: Daemons can now be summoned instantly and the cost of Resummon is reduced to 0 Action Points.

coreAbilities.name: Roiling Winds
coreAbilities.description: Winds tear out from your target, dealing 300 damage to them and everyone within 20 feet every second for 4 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Infernal Pain
coreAbilities.description: Surge of Insanity will now cause an additional 396 Spirit damage over 6 seconds to all targets hit.

coreAbilities.name: Surging Power
coreAbilities.description: Increases critical damage from Infernal Blast, Surging Violet Fire, Flickering Red Fire, and Surge of Insanity by 50%.

coreAbilities.name: Conduit of Chaos
coreAbilities.description: Focusing the great powers of Chaos for 10 seconds, you may tirelessly use all your abilities for no AP cost.

coreAbilities.name: Swift Flames
coreAbilities.description: Reduces Surging Violet Fire's cooldown by 7 seconds.

coreAbilities.name: Daemonic Withering
coreAbilities.description:
Withered Soul will now also cause the victim to suffer 15% more damage from all sources.
Does not affect damage procs.

coreAbilities.name: Unleash the Winds
coreAbilities.description: Deals 1800 damage to all enemies within 25 feet, and for the next 10 seconds your cast times are reduced by 50%, cost 25% less Action Points and you cannot be set back during this time.
